name: progress-bars-need-min-width
hook: Zero-value progress bars need minimum width to remain visible
body: When rendering progress bars for a ranked list where all values may be zero (e.g. course enrollments with no students), use `Math.max(pct, 5)` instead of raw percentage for the bar width. Without a minimum, width:0% bars are invisible even though DOM elements exist, causing both visual and test failures.
why: The CourseEnrollmentsWidget bug: all 8 courses had count=0, so pct=0 for every bar → width:0% → invisible bars. The existing test passed because it never asserted on the bars, only on the section header.
